content.thinking: The reference's `name in fields` check is wrong — `fields` is a list of dicts. Let me fix to check membership by name.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('ref.py').read()
src = src.replace('name = term["field"]; assert name in fields',
                  'name = term["field"]; assert any(f["name"]==name for f in fields)')
open('ref.py','w').write(src)
EOF
cd /app/submission && python3 /app/tmp/ref.py < /app/examples/ambiguity.json && python3 /app/tmp/ref.py < /app/examples/empty.json
